description_expanded: Stork's Nest - Vacation Rental in Gulf Trace Favorite Features: - 3 Gulf Front King Bedrooms - Beachviews - Private Pool - Newly Updated AC system with UV Sanitization - Quiet Neighborhood - Close to Grayton Beach State Park, Seaside, and Blue Mountain Beach More about Stork's Nest: Welcome to Stork’s Nest, one of the most relaxing beachfront homes in secluded South Walton. This 3,000 square foot home sits directly on the gulf and sleeps 20 people comfortably. Stork’s Nest boasts 6 bedrooms, 3 featuring gulf views, and 6 full baths providing private suites for all guests and a private pool! Guests can request pool heat for an additional charge. The home also features two expansive balconies with breathtaking views of the private sugar white sand beach and emerald green waters. The perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee or take in the unparalleled sunsets! Stork’s Nest is located directly on the beach in the secluded neighborhood of Gulf Trace, a peaceful neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. The home offers a wonderfully open floor plan allowing many people to gather in the kitchen and living spaces all overlooking the pristine waters and powder soft sand. Featuring a fully equipped kitchen and multiple dining spaces, this rental home is perfect for large groups and family gatherings. Each bedroom offers a partial, if not, gorgeous unobstructed view of the gulf and a flat screen television. This home has it all if you are looking for the utmost in your Destin vacation. Whether you have come here for rest, play, creative respite, family time or just to linger at the edge of emerald green waters you will find what you have come for. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Deck Access & Gulf View. Bedroom 2: 2 Queen Beds & Ensuite Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 3: 2 Twin over Full Bunks & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 4: 2 Queen Beds & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Shared Balcony & Gulf View. Bedroom 6: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Shared Balcony & Gulf View.
